==Problem 1== Jamie counted the number of edges of a cube, Jimmy counted the numbers of corners, and Judy counted the number of faces. They then added the three numbers. What was the resulting sum? ==Solution== On a cube, there are 12 edges, 8 corners, and 6 faces. Adding them up gets 12+8+6= \boxed{\mathrm{(E)}\ 26} . ==See Also== {{AMC8 box|year=2003|before=First
Question|num-a=2}} {{MAA Notice}}
